learning_outcomes.text: Deepen knowledge of the measurement of mechanical - physical properties of bulk materials, the possibility of using modern laboratory techniques to predict a variety of conditions of transport and process equipment.

syllabus_topics: Measurement of the granulometric parameters of the selected particulate material
Measurement of the rheological parameters of the selected particulate material
Measurement of mechanical - physical properties of particulate material - angle of external friction
Measurement of mechanical - physical properties of particulate material - angle of internal friction
Measurement of humidity and angle of repose of particulate material
Measurement of spring characteristics intended for vibrating conveyors
Verification of Euler's relations on the traction disk of the elevator machine
Measurement of pressure loss in pneumatic transport pipelines
bibliography: Rhodes, M., J.: Principles of Powder Technology, John Wiley and Sons Ltd., ISBN 0-471-92422-9, UK, 1993.
Gotoh, K. and et.: Powder Technology Handbook, ISBN 0-8247-0015-5, Marcel Dekker, Inc., USA, 1997
institution: Vysoka Skola Banska- Technicka Univerzita Ostrava
degree: ECTS course offer for Erasmus+ students - Faculty of Mechanical Engineering (first cycle courses)
